stores.description: Global state management providers using React Context API with AsyncStorage persistence

store.name: profileStore
store.purpose: Manages user profile information including personal details and nutritional goals. Provides global state for user settings and theme preferences.

type.name: ProfileContextType
type.description: Context API type for profile state and methods

fields.field: Whether profile data has finished loading from storage
Method to reset profile to defaults

constants.constant: AsyncStorage key for persisting profile data
Default profile object used on first load

function.name: loadProfile
function.description: Load profile from AsyncStorage or return defaults if not found
function.behavior: - Attempts to read from AsyncStorage using STORAGE_KEY - If data exists, merges it with DEFAULT_PROFILE to ensure all fields are present - If data doesn't exist or JSON parse fails, returns DEFAULT_PROFILE
function.returns: UserProfile object from storage or defaults
function.errorHandling: Catches all exceptions and returns DEFAULT_PROFILE on error

function.name: saveProfile
function.description: Save profile to AsyncStorage
function.behavior: - Converts profile object to JSON string - Writes to AsyncStorage with STORAGE_KEY
function.errorHandling: Does not catch errors; caller must handle

function.name: ProfileProvider
function.signature: function ProfileProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function.description: Context provider component that manages global profile state
function.behavior: 1. Initialize state with DEFAULT_PROFILE 2. Load data from AsyncStorage on mount (useEffect) 3. Save to AsyncStorage whenever profile changes (useEffect) 4. Skip first save after hydration using hasEverSavedRef 5. Provide ProfileContext with state and mutation methods
function.hooks: - useState: manages profile, ready, hydrated state - useRef: isHydratingRef (prevents saving during hydration), hasEverSavedRef (skips first save) - useEffect: loading effect, saving effect
function.contextValue: - ready: boolean indicating if storage is loaded - profile: current UserProfile - updateProfile: updates profile fields - resetProfile: resets to DEFAULT_PROFILE

function.name: updateProfile
function.description: Update one or more profile fields
function.behavior: - Uses spread operator to merge patch with existing profile - Triggers save effect due to profile state change
function.example: updateProfile({ name: "John", age: 30 }) // Only specified fields are updated, others remain unchanged

function.name: resetProfile
function.description: Reset profile to DEFAULT_PROFILE values
function.behavior: - Sets profile state to DEFAULT_PROFILE - Triggers save effect

function.name: useProfile
function.description: Hook to access profile state and methods

persistence.timing: Saved whenever any profile field changes (after initial hydration)
persistence.hydration: 1. Component mounts, sets isHydratingRef.current = true 2. AsyncStorage read initiated 3. Data merged with defaults on read 4. State updated with loaded data 5. isHydratingRef.current = false 6. On next profile change, hasEverSavedRef prevents immediate save (skips first change after load)

usage.context: Wrap your app with ProfileProvider to enable profile state management
usage.hook: Use useProfile() in any descendant component to access profile data

store.name: ingredientsStore
store.purpose: Manages meal planning state including meals, sections, and ingredient items. Supports CRUD operations on meal structures with proportional quantity calculations.

type.name: Item
type.description: Individual ingredient item within a meal section

fields.field: Display name of the ingredient (e.g., "Chicken Breast")
Whether item is selected for the current meal

type.name: Section
type.description: Grouping of items within a meal (e.g., "Proteins", "Vegetables")

fields.field: Array of items in this section

type.name: Meal
type.description: Complete meal structure with multiple sections

fields.field: Array of sections in this meal

type.name: IngredientsContextType
type.description: Context API type for ingredients state

fields.field: Clear all items from all meals

constants.constant: Four default meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Snack, Dinner (all with empty sections)

function.name: loadState
function.description: Load meal data from AsyncStorage or return defaults
function.behavior: - Reads from AsyncStorage using STORAGE_KEY - If successful, returns parsed data ensuring meals array exists - If data missing or invalid, returns DEFAULT_STATE

function.name: saveState
function.description: Save meal data to AsyncStorage
function.behavior: - Converts state to JSON string - Writes to AsyncStorage with STORAGE_KEY

function.name: IngredientsProvider
function.signature: function IngredientsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function.description: Context provider managing global meal planning state
function.behavior: 1. Initialize with DEFAULT_MEALS 2. Load from AsyncStorage on mount 3. Provide CRUD methods for meals, sections, and items 4. Auto-save on state changes (after hydration)
function.contextValue: Provides state and 13 mutation methods for meal management

function.name: addMeal
function.description: Add new meal to the meals array
function.behavior: - Appends meal to end of meals array - Triggers state update and save

function.name: removeMeal
function.description: Remove meal by id
function.behavior: - Filters meals array to exclude matching id - Triggers state update and save

function.name: renameMeal
function.description: Update meal's title
function.behavior: - Maps through meals and updates matching id's title - Triggers state update and save

function.name: addSection
function.description: Add section to specified meal

parameters.param: ID of meal to add section to

function.behavior: - Finds meal by id - Appends section to its sections array - Triggers state update and save

function.name: removeSection
function.description: Remove section from meal
function.behavior: - Finds meal by id - Filters its sections array to exclude matching sectionId - Triggers state update and save

function.name: renameSection
function.signature: (mealId: string, sectionId: string, title: string) => void
function.description: Update section's title within a meal
function.behavior: - Finds meal and maps its sections - Updates title of matching sectionId - Triggers state update and save

function.name: addItem
function.signature: (mealId: string, sectionId: string, newItem: Item) => void
function.description: Add ingredient item to meal section
function.behavior: - Navigates to meal → section - Appends newItem to items array - Triggers state update and save

function.name: removeItem
function.signature: (mealId: string, sectionId: string, itemId: string) => void
function.description: Remove item from meal section
function.behavior: - Navigates to meal → section → items - Filters out matching itemId - Triggers state update and save

function.name: updateItem
function.signature: (mealId: string, sectionId: string, itemId: string, patch: Partial<Item>) => void
function.description: Update item properties using partial object
function.behavior: - Navigates to meal → section → items - Merges patch into matching itemId - Triggers state update and save

function.name: toggleItem
function.signature: (mealId: string, sectionId: string, itemId: string) => void
function.description: Toggle item's checked status
function.behavior: - Finds item and inverts its checked boolean - Triggers state update and save

function.name: resetMeals
function.description: Reset meals to DEFAULT_MEALS
function.behavior: - Sets meals to DEFAULT_MEALS (clears all user data) - Triggers state update and save

function.name: clearMealContents
function.description: Clear all items from all meals (keeps structure)
function.behavior: - Maps through all meals and sections - Sets items array to empty array - Keeps meal and section structure intact - Triggers state update and save

function.name: calculateProportionalQty
function.signature: function calculateProportionalQty(mealId: string, sectionId: string, itemId: string): string
function.description: Calculate quantity for an item based on proportional weights of selected items
function.returns: Formatted quantity string with unit (e.g., "150 g")
function.logic: 1. Filter items to get only checked items in section 2. Find target item 3. Sum weights of all checked items (default weight: 1) 4. Guard against division by zero 5. Calculate: (itemWeight / totalWeight) * baseQty 6. Round to 2 decimal places 7. Format: remove trailing zeros, append unit

function.name: useIngredients
function.description: Hook to access ingredients state and methods

persistence.format: JSON string of PersistedState object with meals array
persistence.timing: Saved whenever any meal structure changes (after initial hydration)

feature.name: Proportional Quantity Calculation
feature.description: Automatically calculates item quantities based on proportional weights
feature.use-case: When multiple ingredients are selected, adjust quantity of each to maintain proportions
feature.example:
Breakfast with Proteins section: - Chicken (weight: 1, baseQty: 150g) - checked - Eggs (weight: 1, baseQty: 100g) - checked - Bacon (weight: 1, baseQty: 50g) - checked
Result: Each item displays 1/3 of its base quantity - Chicken: 50g - Eggs: 33.33g → 33.33 - Bacon: 16.67g → 16.67

store.name: historyStore
store.purpose: Manages history of consumed meals with timestamps, meal types, ingredients consumed, and personal notes. Enables tracking of eating patterns over time.

type.name: HistoryIngredient
type.description: Ingredient consumed in a logged meal

fields.field: ISO 8601 date string of when meal was consumed
Array of ingredients in this meal

type.name: HistoryContextType
type.description: Context API type for history state

function.name: loadHistory
function.description: Load meal history from AsyncStorage
function.returns: Array of history entries or empty array if not found
function.errorHandling: Catches exceptions and returns empty array

function.name: saveHistory
function.description: Save meal history to AsyncStorage
function.behavior: - Converts entries array to JSON string - Writes to AsyncStorage with STORAGE_KEY

function.name: HistoryProvider
function.signature: function HistoryProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function.description: Context provider managing global meal history state
function.behavior: 1. Initialize with empty entries array 2. Load from AsyncStorage on mount 3. Provide CRUD methods for history entries 4. Auto-save on state changes (after hydration)
function.contextValue: Provides state and 4 mutation methods for history management

function.name: addEntry
function.description: Add new meal entry to history
function.behavior: - Prepends entry to beginning of entries array (newest first) - Triggers state update and save
function.example: addEntry({ id: `${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}`, mealType: "Breakfast", date: new Date().toISOString(), ingredients: [{ id: "1", label: "Eggs", quantity: 2, unit: "count" }], notes: "Tasty breakfast!" })

function.name: updateEntry
function.description: Update entry properties using partial object
function.behavior: - Finds entry by id - Merges patch into entry object - Triggers state update and save

function.name: removeEntry
function.description: Remove entry from history by id
function.behavior: - Filters entries array to exclude matching id - Triggers state update and save

function.name: clearHistory
function.description: Clear all history entries
function.behavior: - Sets entries array to empty array - Triggers state update and save

function.name: useHistory
function.description: Hook to access history state and methods

persistence.ordering: Newest entries prepended to array (reverse chronological)
persistence.timing: Saved whenever entries change (after initial hydration)

usage.context: Wrap your app with HistoryProvider to enable history tracking
usage.hook: Use useHistory() in any descendant component to access history data

store.name: groceriesStore
store.purpose: Manages grocery shopping list with simple items, quantities, and checklist tracking. Note: Implemented as a custom hook (useGroceries) instead of a provider.

type.name: GroceryItem
type.description: Single grocery item on shopping list

function.name: loadGroceries
function.description: Load grocery list from AsyncStorage
function.returns: Array of grocery items or empty array if not found
function.errorHandling: Catches exceptions and returns empty array

function.name: saveGroceries
function.description: Save grocery list to AsyncStorage
function.behavior: - Converts items array to JSON string - Writes to AsyncStorage with STORAGE_KEY

function.name: useGroceries
function.description: Hook to manage grocery list state and operations
function.returns: Object with state and mutation methods
function.behavior: 1. Initialize with empty items array 2. Load from AsyncStorage on mount 3. Save whenever items change (after hydration) 4. Return state and methods to caller
function.hooks: - useState: manages items, ready, hydrated state - useRef: isHydratingRef, hasEverSavedRef - useEffect: loading effect, saving effect

function.name: addItem
function.description: Add new item to grocery list
function.behavior: - Appends item to end of items array - Triggers save

function.name: updateItem
function.description: Update item properties
function.behavior: - Finds item by id - Merges patch into item - Triggers save

function.name: removeItem
function.description: Remove item from list
function.behavior: - Filters items to exclude matching id - Triggers save

function.name: toggleItem
function.description: Toggle item's checked status
function.behavior: - Inverts checked boolean for matching item - Triggers save

function.name: clearChecked
function.description: Remove all checked items from list
function.behavior: - Filters items to keep only unchecked items - Triggers save
function.use-case: After finishing shopping, remove completed items

function.name: clearAll
function.description: Remove all items from list
function.behavior: - Sets items to empty array - Triggers save

persistence.timing: Saved whenever items change (after initial hydration)

differences.note: Unlike other stores, groceriesStore is a custom hook instead of a Context provider
differences.implication: Can be used in multiple places with separate state instances, or wrapped in a custom provider
differences.usage: Use directly with useGroceries() hook, or create a provider wrapper if global state is needed
